team: IRAOLA: “WE HAVE TO CONGRATULATE ARSENAL!”  Bournemouth
speaker: Head Coach
quote_text:
Okay, kick us off. Andoni, you've done it. Can we  talk about European qualification? Yeah, of course  
we can. We should. I think what a night it has  been. I have enjoyed all the night, all the game.  
Probably the only thing you  would change is the result,  
because I honestly think we should have won  the game, 2-0 or 3-0 probably. But it does not  
change so much our position in terms of European  qualification. We have the Europa League  
already guaranteed, and even a small chance, but  even a chance, to fight for the Champions League  
until the end. And on the game itself, obviously  you sort of rode a bit of a storm early on,  
seemed to defend quite well, and then the  lead with that wonderful Kroupi goal. Just  
a word on him. I think he has broken the record  for the most goals from a teenager in a debut  
Premier League season. I think we played so well  today. So, so well, on the ball, without the ball.  
Obviously there are moments against City, always  you know that they are going to push you and they  
are going to have their chances. But even during  the game, it is a game where there is a lot to  
play for, and you have some nerves and this. But  I was enjoying the game. And talking about Junior,  
Junior has grown so much this season. So much. It  was difficult when we started the pre-season to  
envision a little bit how he has evolved. He  has found another position. He has given us  
a lot of things apart from the goals. We know his  finishing is top, he is never going to lose this.  
But he is a much more complete  player and it has allowed him to play  
a lot more minutes and take the chances like  today. And in the second half, obviously  
you seemed to be almost a better team for much of  the second half and City came back into it in the  
last five, ten minutes. How pleased were  you with the reaction? I sort of sat up,  
sat in the press box thinking about the cup  game last season, where you were 1-0 up and  
City always looked like coming back. It did  not feel like that. No, I think we played much,  
much better than that game. I think City played  really well that past season cup game. Today  
I think it was a difficult game for City. They  are coming from a busy schedule. They played a  
cup final three days ago. It is not because you  play a game three days ago and you are going  
to be a little bit more tired, because they are  used to this. But I think the tension of a final,  
even in the muscles, even if it is not  the same, I have played some finals and  
it does not matter what happens, you need  time to recover now from those emotions.  
I think it was difficult for City today and  I think we have benefited from it. I do not  
want to take anything from my team, from  my players. I think we played really well.  
But from their side, I think it  was a difficult game in terms of  
schedule. And when that final whistle went, what  was the overriding emotion as the whistle went?  
Yeah, we have been so close. We were  so close. Even you hear the news,  
they had 90-something chance of getting it, but  
you want to grab it and you want to guarantee  it, and we have done it. We have done it.  
I think we have missed incredible chances.  Brooks has missed two incredible chances. But  
then it does not matter. I have enjoyed the night.  I have enjoyed the night even before the end.  
I was watching also the supporters bouncing,  incredible atmosphere, and I think the European  
qualification is incredible. But the moments that  we will remember from this night, I think are even  
more important. And I guess the mindset going  into Forest is, let us see what that brings.  
Yes, yes. Now we have probably not a lot of  pressure, but there are challenges there we want  
to maximise. We do not know if Villa is going to  win the Europa League. I hope so. Now we are big  
Villa supporters. But some things have to happen  now to give us chances. But also we have the  
challenge, and we have spoken about not losing any  game in the second half of the season, and we have  
just one team remaining. We have not lost against  any opposition in the second game of the season,  
and when you have it so close, I do not know how  many teams have done this, but I suppose not a lot  
of teams. So I think we are close also to getting  this thing. That is not minor for me, and I would  
definitely love to finish without a loss this  second half of the season. Finally for me, just on  
tonight's game, on the two full-backs, I thought  they were standouts for me. Adrien and Truffert  
was excellent at both ends, and Adam Smith  dealt with Doku really, really well. Just  
how pleased were you with both of those? They are  so reliable. I think they are so, so reliable.  
Sometimes they play better, they play worse on the  ball, they are sharper, or in different styles.  
Probably Smudge is in a moment where he  wants to solidify defensively and then add  
very good balls from the back, because he has  very good quality on the ball to put these  
intervals that we say. And Adri has now  the defensive thing, and that does not stop  
offensively. He gives us so much and he is  improving a lot in his final decisions, in his  
balls to the edge. The goal today is a lovely,  lovely goal and good finish, but all the play,  
and I am very happy for them. It is very difficult  to get players to come with you. How have you  
managed to keep them with you when you have played  this on the side? I think it has been even almost  
a positive thing in terms of the things have  been so clear between the club, between me,  
between the players. I think we did everything in  two, three days. Okay, this is the decision, I am  
not going to continue. We are going to sign this  manager. By the way, he is a very good manager.  
And I think we have tried to say, okay,  we do not have a lot of time together,  
let us try to maximise it, let us try to enjoy  what we have. I think now every game has been  
like this. Even now I am thinking, we do not  have a lot, but we still have three trainings,  
one game. Let us try to finish it  well and create even bigger memories.  
No, I said it a lot of times. It has been a  difficult season in terms of taking the decision.  
For me, I have had different moments during  the season and it has been a lot of headaches.  
But once you get to the decision and you decide,  I think you feel relieved. Relieved. And it has  
helped me a little bit to enjoy even the last  two months. I feel now I am so, so happy because  
I kind of can give back to the club, to the  supporters, to the players, everything that I have  
received. And with this European qualification,  I feel like, okay, at least we have this. Andoni,  
your draw made Arsenal champions tonight, the  kingmakers. What tribute would you pay to Arsenal?  
I think we have to congratulate Arsenal. I think  they fully deserved it. I think they have been so,  
so consistent during the past seasons and  improving a little bit more, improving a  
little bit more. I am very happy for Mikel, very  happy for Kepa, who was here with us last season,  
very happy for Arsenal because I think they  have been very good. Obviously we were today  
trying to get Europe, trying to fight for our  result, but on the personal side, I am also very  
happy for Mikel. Pep confirmed what he is doing  after Sunday. Can you give us any clarity on  
what you are going to be doing after Sunday?  No, I do not know what I am going to do. I think  
I will enjoy definitely this four, five days,  enjoy it. And then when we finish the game against  
Forest, we will start to think what we  do. Right now in my head it is just,  
let us finish it even better if we can, and then  there will be time to talk about the next stages.  
You and Mikel go back a long way. Are  you expecting a big bottle of champagne?  
It would be lovely, something. I do not know,  
I have not even checked my phone. I should have  at least one text message or something. But  
I think it was not because of this game. Probably  they were even going to finish it for sure  
themselves. I am happy for him because I  think he has done an incredible job there  
for a lot of seasons. Very consistent, and  sometimes has been so close that the reward has  
come, probably in the right moment. They even have  now the challenge of a Champions League final,  
could be incredible for him, and I hope  they finish also there. Have you spoken?  
No, we have not spoken. No, we have not spoken.  I think we respect a lot the managers. Normally  
we do not speak a lot. After, you speak or you see  each other and you are three hours talking. But  
normally in this kind of situations, I  will congratulate him, I will send him a  
message. But no, we have not spoken  before the game. See you on Friday.
title: IRAOLA: “WE HAVE TO CONGRATULATE ARSENAL!”  Bournemouth 1-1 Man City
